title: Standard WOFOST one-day event and transaction contract

scope.first_scientific_admission_window: one explicit crop-evolution day equivalent to the B1.10 daily oracle

authorities.crop_window_scheduling_and_aggregate_com: runtime/event layer outside the crop kernel

conceptual_event.signature: evolve_crop(parameters, committed_crop_state, crop_event_forcing, accepted_process_aggregates, t0, t1) -> candidate_crop_state + crop_results + diagnostics

two_phase_window_semantics.reason: B1.10 assimilation runs at day start, while actual crop evolution and root extension run at day end after soil-water aggregates have been accumulated.

prepare_phase.input_origin: committed crop checkpoint at the previous crop-event boundary plus explicit current-window forcing
candidate_only_climate_memory: atmin7 candidate shift with current TMN
derived_window_context: other rate/intermediate values needed before finalization
prepare_phase.read_only_same_window_exports: only explicitly qualified process inputs may be exposed to soil-water/oxygen processing; no crop state is committed here

accumulate_phase.lineage_rule: every contribution is bound to the same crop-window identity and accepted physical lineage
accumulate_phase.rule_if_window_spans_multiple_commits: runtime may persist only the accepted aggregate/window provenance, not WOFOST rates or a half-committed crop candidate

finalize_phase.input: same committed crop origin, deterministic prepared context, frozen accepted aggregates and explicit [t0,t1]
operations: compute actual water-stress reduction from accepted IQROT/IPTRA
update active leaf cohorts exactly once under the qualified daily cadence
update TSUM/DVS/anthesis and optional vernalization state
update option-dependent root state or derived root geometry according to separately qualified root ownership
finalize_phase.output: complete candidate crop continuation plus results/diagnostics

always_common: actual WOFOST biomass and active LV/SLA/LVAGE cohort history

root_option_state.SWRD1: no independent root-depth state; derive from committed DVS and parameters
root_option_state.SWRD2: actual and potential root-depth history is optional committed physical state and must transact atomically with crop evolution
root_option_state.SWRD3: actual root depth is derivable from committed actual WRT and parameters
root_option_state.SWRDC1: adaptive per-node root biomass/distribution history is optional committed physical state and must transact atomically

transaction_rules.trial_origin: clone of committed crop continuation or F-KT checkpoint clone
transaction_rules.warm_start: numerical/worker-local only; may not replace committed physical origin

required_structural_candidate_tests: checkpoint -> crop trial -> discard -> exact committed crop owner unchanged
same checkpoint + same forcing + same frozen accepted aggregates -> exact same candidate
rejected soil-water retry contributes zero to crop-window aggregates
accepted substep replay cannot double-book IQROT/IPTRA/IALPWET
one crop window with many soil-water substeps performs one WOFOST cohort shift/create operation
all enabled optional root state rolls back atomically with phenology and biomass
inactive IDSL2 option allocates no vernalization state
inactive adaptive-root options allocate no per-node root state

initial_candidate_restriction_option.allowed_for_smallest_first_production_se: a future structural unit may first admit a root configuration with no independent root-history allocation and may exclude oxygen cross-window exports, provided the execution class is explicit and physics is not silently changed
examples: IDSL=0 or 1 while IDSL2 vernrate semantics remain held
SWRD=1 or another route whose root depth is reconstructible from already committed crop state

forbidden: commit nofd/atmin7 at day start before the parent transaction is accepted
advance crop once per Richards or Newton substep
store daily WOFOST rates as permanent per-column state
let rejected soil-water trials leak into crop-window aggregates
give crop code a second commit/rollback authority
require the generic kernel interval itself to be exactly one day
